title: ODS Custom Profile Definition Schema (v1.1.0)
description: Machine-readable JSON Schema for custom profile declarations in ODS (ods.custom_profile) in v1.1.0. name is optional; when absent the profile-definition file stem is used. Section contracts may be declared either via required_sections/optional_sections or as ## headings in the definition file body; see specs/profiles.md#711-profile-definition-metadata.

name.description: Unique lowercase identifier for the profile (e.g. 'okf', 'rfc', 'incident', 'benchmark').

description.description: Human-readable description of what this profile represents and when to use it.

required_sections.description: List of Markdown H2/H3 heading titles that MUST be present in conforming documents.

optional_sections.description: List of Markdown H2/H3 heading titles that MAY be present in conforming documents.

required_keys.description: List of frontmatter keys required for this profile.

optional_keys.description: Top-level document keys documented for the profile but not required.

forbidden_keys.description: List of frontmatter keys that are forbidden for this profile.
